office_does: Superior Court judges hear felonies, civil suits and family, juvenile and probate cases for Ferry, Pend Oreille and Stevens counties.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Thomas Webster, appointed in January 2026, is the only candidate for the two-year unexpired term.

candidates.summary: Superior Court judge appointed in January 2026 after 25 years in private practice, mostly civil litigation.
highlights: Appointed and sworn in January 23, 2026, replacing retiring Judge Jessica Taylor Reeves [S1][S2]
Ran Webster Law Office in Colville from 2009 to 2025 [S1]
Says he will apply the law strictly and stay out of partisanship [S2]
